name: dsh-chrome-bridge
description: DSH plugin: native browser_* tools that drive the Chrome you are already using — over native messaging + CDP. No WebSocket, no port, no Connect button. One-time host install required (repo install.sh + Chrome extension, see README); tools fail loudly until then.
author: OrderG-X

meta.title: Chrome Bridge
meta.description: 原生 browser_* 工具，直接操作用户正在用的 Chrome（native messaging + CDP）。需先按 README 装一次宿主与 Chrome 扩展，未装时工具会明确报错
